subject: Dedicated capacity demo / throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Samantha Miller <s.miller@finly.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood Dedicated for production inference

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the self-serve trial and are very interested in a Dedicated deployment for production. A quick summary of our needs: we run a document-processing feature that will call generation models for ~100 concurrent users, peak bursts to 500 concurrent requests, and an estimated steady-state of ~40-60 req/s. Typical responses are ~512 tokens. Our SLO is p95 latency under 350ms for 512-token responses; we need predictable throughput and isolation for PII-sensitive data.

I attached our performance requirements doc - happy to jump on a quick call / demo to see Dedicated capacity and understand pricing.

Thanks,
Samantha Miller
Head of AI Platform
Finly Inc.
[Attachment: Finly_performance_requirements.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)]

Hi Marissa,

Thanks - Wed 2026-07-14 14:00 PDT works best for us. Per your request, attaching a short set of representative prompts and an outline of our traffic patterns. A couple clarifications:
- Steady-state expected ~50 req/s (512-token average); bursts to 500 req/s for short windows (a few minutes).
- We require p95 < 350ms for 512 tokens for ~80% of calls; for a subset of requests we can accept higher latency but would like to understand tradeoffs.
- We're interested in dedicated GPUs with predictable throughput and KV/prefix caching to reduce cost.

Attached: Finly_performance_requirements.pdf, finly_prompts_sample.txt

See you Wed.

Hi Samantha - Aditya here. Confirming Wed 2026-07-14 14:00 PDT for the demo. Quick notes on prep:
- We'll provision a short-lived Dedicated test environment for the demo to reproduce your workload (512-token median) and run a 10 minute sustained test at 50 req/s and a short burst test to ~500 req/s to show graceful degradation/fallback.
- For the p95 target: in many configs p95 for 512 tokens sits between 250-400ms depending on model variant and quantization. We'll show tradeoffs (latency vs cost) and caching strategies.
- Please upload the sample prompts here prior to the demo: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finly-sample-prompts (or reply with the file).

I'll bring the Dedicated pricing reference and a procurement checklist (SOC 2 artifacts, TLS/KMS details, PII controls). Looking forward to it.
